//: NODE-ONLY INTEGRATION TESTS THAT DRIVE THE WORKER'S OWN HANDLERS ON THE REAL KERNEL. They need what `../node-tests` has (Node globals and the WebAssembly kernel, which cannot start under jsdom) AND the worker's handler modules, which name `Worker` and `Transferable` through the Boolean controller and therefore compile only with a lib that declares them. So this project takes the DOM lib on top of Node types, and nothing else is allowed in: worker code itself is still checked under the WebWorker lib in `../tsconfig.json`, and kernel-only tests stay in `../node-tests`.
